performance_case.causal_mechanism: Removing non-executable documentation, test, governance and historical-only hash coupling from runtime self-attestation can prevent ordinary repository maintenance from disabling the fixed post-positive design path while preserving all executable, schema, scientific task and path gates.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may establish only static dependency and implementation readiness. It cannot access outcomes or establish prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any market drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a later preregistered matched-capital experiment passes independent Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Keeping unnecessary pins may repeatedly stall a valid forward-learning path after routine maintenance; removing a real authority pin could weaken fail-closed evidence, so the audit must retain every executable, scientific and fixed-path dependency.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: A smaller sufficient runtime trust root cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but should reduce avoidable runner unavailability and time to a credible accept-or-reject strategy decision without adding variants or relaxing evidence gates.
